fields.options: Configure the default Job Applicant profile setup that every new Job Opening inherits. Admins can override these per-opening on the Job Opening's Job application tab. The list auto-syncs from the Job Applicant doctype every time you open this page — new fields appear automatically.

fields.label: Synced field refs (internal)
fields.description: Newline-separated list of Job Applicant field refs that have already been imported. Anything in this list is never re-added by auto-sync — lets manual deletes stick while still picking up brand-new fields added to Job Applicant later.
